findings.issue: Hithpael imperfect 3ms of H2398 licenses the man purifying himself; «se pecará» states reflexive sinning and changes stem force.
Piel perfect 3ms with את has the man defiling the sanctuary as object; «el mikdash de Jehová impureció» makes the sanctuary the subject and drops that object role.
מקדש (H4720) is a common noun left as the untranslated dump mikdash.
זרק is qal perfect 3ms active with מי as the fronted object; «fueron echadas» is feminine plural passive and makes the waters the subject.
נדה (H5079) is a common noun left as the untranslated dump nidá.
Qal imperfect 3ms is indicative; subjunctive «se impurezca» is mood smoothing in the relative clause.

notes: Jehová, the niphal cut-off of הנפש ההוא, מתוך הקהל, עליו, and verbless טמא הוא match the tokens.
